comments.author: dvakatsiienko
comments.text:
Hi, I'd like to pick this one up if nobody on the team has started it.

The fix I have in mind is small. The watcher in `WorkflowProductionChecklist.vue` would read the saved settings itself right before the first-time check, since the value `onMounted` loads may not be there yet on a reload. I'd add a unit test that fails on master (settings arriving after the watcher fires) and passes with the change.

If you'd rather handle it in-house or want a different approach, say so and I'll leave it.

— printed by Claude Code, signed by me.
